title: Choir and Garden
author: Xanthe Pemberton
blurb: Mara Sterling, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
